name: Honeyglass Watch
image_style: A striking 16:10 landscape desktop wallpaper rendered as a luminous botanical photogram: layered beeswax sheets, pressed meadow plants, translucent vellum, fine cyanotype-like silhouettes, and delicate hand-scored linework create a tactile archival image with shallow material depth. The mood is pastoral, nocturnal, contemplative, and affectionately deadpan, combining natural-history precision with the solemn absurdity of an unmistakable visitor. Use ink-dark fir, midnight blue, honeyed parchment, muted lavender, oxidized teal, and restrained vermilion; let translucent amber light pass through wax and wings without becoming glossy. Preserve a broad quiet upper edge for the desktop bar and a calm shadowed lower-left region for widgets, concentrating detail in the lower-right garden and hive structures. No lettering, logos, watermark, border, frame, or interface elements.
scene: Exactly one striking 16:10 landscape wallpaper, preferably 2560x1600, set in a historically grounded monastic herb garden at blue hour, treated as a secular botanical study rather than a devotional scene. Low espaliered trees, woven fencing, beehives, lavender beds, espalier ladders, clay pots, and a small timber honey house sit beneath a broad darkening sky. A beekeeper in practical medieval clothing calmly inspects a frame while bees drift through the cool air. In the lower-right, Space Ghost is unmistakable in his muscular white costume, black hood and mask, yellow cape, and red power bands, wearing an absurdly tiny beekeeper veil over his hood and holding a smoking bee smoker with absolute professional seriousness. Several bees land harmlessly on his cape while he carefully records their flight with a brass compass; the beekeeper continues working with restrained bewilderment. The joke belongs only to his misplaced expertise. Keep the upper edge spacious and quiet, with a calm dark garden path at lower left for widgets. No sacred figures, halos, worship, devotional attributes, text, lettering, logos, UI, watermark, or frame.
